ns2:section.sectionText: This course has a small number of seats reserved for non-degree students, per an agreement with CITL. If you receive an error about a "restriction" when trying to register, then the section is full, except for the reserved seats. Any of these unused seats remaining by the end of the first week of instruction will be opened for any student to take. For up-to-date information about statistics course registration, please see our registration update pages: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration
